name: oh-my-design
title_zh: 先出三版视觉稿再谈实现的UI设计台
tagline_zh: 还在为「做个界面」来回改稿？它一次给三版视觉方向，从布局到配色都摆在你面前，选完再动手写代码，省下整周的返工时间。
tagline_en: Tired of endless UI revisions? Get 3 concrete visual directions—layout, color, feel—laid out for you to pick.
desc_en: Use this skill when the user asks to design / mock up / prototype a UI, iterate on visual design, compare visual candidates, or explore visual approaches before implementation. Triggered by phrases like "design a UI", "mockup", "prototype the screen", "give me 3 visual options", "make it look like…", or any request that is fundamentally about look-and-feel rather than business logic. The skill wri
why_zh: 把「视觉探索」和「代码实现」彻底切开：先专注产出候选方案，用具体画面逼你做出选择。
why_en: Separates visual exploration from implementation: forces concrete choices with tangible mockups instead of vague back-and-forth.
limit_zh: 只产出视觉稿和设计方向，不生成可运行代码；需要你后续自己实现或接其他编码工具。适合前端项目，对后端或数据逻辑无帮助。
limit_en: Outputs visual mockups only—no runnable code. Front-end focused; no help with backend or data logic.
title_en: UI design desk that shows 3 visual directions before you.
